data.name: Euthenia Energy Group
data.description: Euthenia Energy Group is a Spain-based renewable energy developer whose flagship asset is the Euthenia Energy Center biochar facility in Lucena (Córdoba), designed to produce up to 10,000 tons/year of biochar from olive orchard residues. The company is registered on Puro.earth (4,520 CORCs issued, 2,198 retired as of crediting period 2024–2029), sells credits through Supercritical (e.g., to EcoVadis), is a member of the European Biochar Industry Association, and co-organized the 2025 European Biochar CDR Conference in Málaga with Beston Group. Alongside biochar, the group also develops biofuels, syngas, biogas, solar and green-H2 projects in Europe and the Caribbean.
